text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 3)
Notification 2016
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1 January 2017 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

1.The background of the silver and nickel-plated zinc coins, except for the $80 silver proof-like coin, is shiny silver.
2.The background of the $80 silver proof-like coin is matt silver.
3.The background of the gold coins is shiny gold.
4.The Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year-date “2017” below it.
5.The word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms.
6.The mintmark is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms at 5 o’clock for all the proof coins.
1.The background of the silver and nickel-plated zinc coins is shiny silver.
2.The background of the gold coins is shiny gold.
3.The coins, except for the $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin and the $80 silver proof-like coin, share a common design which features —
(a)a rooster engraved in the centre;
(b)kampong houses of Kampong Buangkok engraved on the left side and partially covered by the rooster;
(c)banana leaves engraved on the right side and partially covered by the rooster;
(d)the respective denominations in figures engraved and placed at 12 o’clock, above the rooster; and
(e)the weight in troy oz and fineness of the coin, engraved above the denomination of the coin, except for the $2 nickel-plated zinc proof-like coin.
4.The rooster featured in the $5 silver proof colour coin and $2 silver proof-like colour coin is featured in colour.
5.The $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin features —
(a)a rooster engraved in the centre;
(b)the denomination “$5” engraved and placed at 6 o’clock, below the rooster; and
(c)the weight in grams and fineness of the coin, engraved and placed at 12 o’clock, above the rooster.
6.The $80 silver proof-like coin features —
(a)a rooster engraved in the centre with high relief;
(b)kampong houses of Kampong Buangkok partially overlapping a banana tree engraved on the left side and partially covered by the rooster;
(c)kampong houses of Kampong Buangkok and banana leaves engraved on the right side and partially covered by the rooster;
(d)the denomination “$80”, engraved and placed at 9 o’clock, just left of the rooster, and partially overlapping feature (b); and
(e)the weight in kilograms and fineness of the coin, engraved and placed at 12 o’clock, above the rooster.
